enough_title: Is Free already enough for you?
enough_body: If you need a till that records sales, Free is enough — and that's fine. If you also want to change stock and prices, look up an old order, refund a customer or take cards on a connected reader, that's Pro.

licence_terms: Yearly never renews by itself. When it ends, Pro keeps working; updates and support stop.
